more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: L-cysteine is used as a flavour enhancer in food. Its technological role is to strengthen flavours already present in food.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include flours. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: The EU specification covers L-cysteine hydrochloride and its monohydrate. It explicitly excludes human hair as a source, but does not establish the production route for every supplier.
